title: GLMP sequenceAnnotation schema
description: Field definitions for linking flowchart nodes to cis-regulatory DNA sequence and logical operators. Version 0.2 extends v0.1 blocks already present in ground-truth process JSON.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for this annotation block.

regulatoryRegions.description: Binding sites and regulatory elements that implement logic in the diagram.

name.description: Human-readable label (e.g. lacO1 operator, GATA1 promoter).

nodeId.description: Optional Mermaid node id this region annotates.

boundFactor.description: Transcription factor, repressor, or complex that binds the site.

operator.description: Logical primitive at this site: NOT, AND, OR, IF, XOR, etc.

effect.description: Molecular outcome: repression, activation, cooperative binding, etc.

sequenceMotif.description: Short motif label or IUPAC consensus when full sequence is unknown.

pwmSource.description: Database or method used for motif definition.

assembly.description: Reference genome build (e.g. GRCh38, GRCm39, U00096.3).

spacingBp.description: Distance in bp to the next annotated site (encodes AND/OR geometry).

orientation.description: Relative orientation to partner site for cooperative logic.

sourceDoi.description: DOI of the paper supporting this site-level annotation.

derivedLogic.description: Boolean formula summarizing how annotated sites compose circuit logic.

references.description: Short citations for the annotation set.

copernicusIntegration.description: Optional top-level process fields linking the chart to CopernicusAI (not part of sequenceAnnotation).

canonicalSourceDoi.description: Primary source paper DOI from flowchart-source-papers.tsv.

copernicusPaperId.description: Firestore document id when the source paper is in the Copernicus corpus (e.g. pubmed_13718526, crossref_10.1016_...).

changelog.notes: Initial regulatoryRegions blocks on ground-truth synthetic, human, plant, and microbial charts.
Added pwmSource/pwmId, genomicCoordinates, spacingBp, orientation, confidence, sourceDoi, nodeId; documented copernicusIntegration process-level fields for CopernicusAI linking.
